Where bdhs keeps your DHS microdata

Source: R/store.R
bdhs_data_dir.Rd

bdhs_data_dir() returns the directory of the local data store used by bdhs_import() and bdhs_read(). It is resolved in this order:

Usage

bdhs_data_dir(path = NULL)

Arguments

path

Optional new data directory. It is set for the current R session only (as the bdhs.data_dir option); the message tells you the line to add to your .Renviron to make it permanent. Nothing is written to your configuration files.

Value

The data directory, as a normalised path (invisibly when path is given).

Details

  1. the bdhs.data_dir option,

  2. the BDHS_DATA_DIR environment variable,

  3. tools::R_user_dir("bdhs", "data").

The directory is created only when you first import data. DHS microdata are licensed to you personally: keep the store on an encrypted disk, and outside git repositories and cloud-synchronised folders (Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, iCloud). bdhs_import() and bdhs_sitrep() warn when it is not.

See also

Other data store: bdhs_download(), bdhs_forget(), bdhs_identify_file(), bdhs_import(), bdhs_inventory(), bdhs_read(), bdhs_read_file(), bdhs_sitrep()

Examples

bdhs_data_dir()
#> [1] "/home/runner/.local/share/R/bdhs"

# Use another location for this session
old <- options(bdhs.data_dir = NULL)
bdhs_data_dir(file.path(tempdir(), "bdhs-data"))
#> ✔ bdhs data directory set to /tmp/RtmpoHb29v/bdhs-data for this R session.
#> ℹ To keep it in future sessions, add this line to your .Renviron (for example
#>   with `usethis::edit_r_environ()`):
#>   `BDHS_DATA_DIR=/tmp/RtmpoHb29v/bdhs-data`
bdhs_data_dir()
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpoHb29v/bdhs-data"
options(old)
